A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we study the properties of Poisson processes where time is changed by compound Poisson processes and the time is also changed by the compound Poisson processes.
the time-changed processes are Poisson processes with a modified intensity.
the hitting times of these processes are expressed by the sums of the hitting times of the Poisson processes with the constant time.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the hitting times of the time-changed processes are not necessarily independent and the independence of the hitting times is not preserved by the iteration.
